title: Tiny, cute drum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Drum body - bright red cylinder -->
  <rect x='22' y='38' width='56' height='34' rx='2' fill='#e83535'/>
  <!-- Drum body shading - lighter red highlights -->
  <rect x='22' y='38' width='56' height='10' rx='2' fill='#ff5555'/>
  <!-- Drum body stripes - golden yellow -->
  <rect x='22' y='52' width='56' height='4' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <rect x='22' y='64' width='56' height='4' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <!-- Bottom rim - darker red shade -->
  <rect x='20' y='68' width='60' height='6' rx='3' fill='#b02020'/>
  <!-- Top drum head - cream/white -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='28' ry='10' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- Top drum head inner line - warm beige -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='24' ry='8' fill='none' stroke='#d4b896' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Rim of top head - golden -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='28' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#ffcc33' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- Cute face on drum head - two happy eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='37' r='2.5' fill='#5a3a1a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='37' r='2.5' fill='#5a3a1a'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='42.8' cy='36.2' r='0.8' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <circle cx='58.8' cy='36.2' r='0.8' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- Blush cheeks - pink -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='40' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#ff9999'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='40' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#ff9999'/>
  <!-- Cute smile -->
  <path d='M46 41 Q50 45 54 41' fill='none' stroke='#5a3a1a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Drum lugs/pegs - small gold dots around top -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='38' r='2' fill='#ffdd55'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='38' r='2' fill='#ffdd55'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='2' fill='#ffdd55'/>
  <!-- Side lug dots -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='53' r='1.5' fill='#ffdd55'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='53' r='1.5' fill='#ffdd55'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='65' r='1.5' fill='#ffdd55'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='65' r='1.5' fill='#ffdd55'/>
  <!-- Drumstick left - angled -->
  <line x1='30' y1='22' x2='40' y2='32' stroke='#c8884a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Drumstick right - angled -->
  <line x1='70' y1='22' x2='60' y2='32' stroke='#c8884a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Drumstick tips - lighter tan -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='22' r='3' fill='#e8b878'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='22' r='3' fill='#e8b878'/>
  <!-- Sparkle decoration -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#ffdd55'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#ffdd55'/>
</svg>
